subject: Vendor consolidation: AlphaEngage quote and next steps
messages:

To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AlphaEngage final quote and SOC2

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the time last week. Per our conversation, attached is the final quote for the 150-seat sequence + 25 admin licenses and the proposed migration SOW. We applied the promotional consolidation discount (28%) on the packaged SKU for customers consolidating sequences and CRM integrations.

Attachments: AlphaEngage_Quote_20250610.pdf, SOW_AlphaEngage_Migration_v1.docx, SOC2_Report_2024.pdf

Key points:
- 150 user seats for sequences + 25 admin seats
- HubSpot integration connector included (no additional per-seat fee)
- Migration support: 6-week program, includes data mapping, 2 on-site workshops or virtual equivalent
- Pricing term: 12-month commitment, billed annually; optional 24-month at additional 4% savings

If this aligns I can get Legal to push final contract and Soc2 attestation over. We can also provide a 30-day pilot for a subset of teams if you want to validate data sync and templates.

DocuSign link will be provided once you confirm the final terms you want to proceed with.

Best,

- Expected 10-12% reduction in month-to-month per-token/seat operational overhead due to built-in syncing and prefix caching optimizations they claim in the SOW
- Proposed migration timeline is 6 weeks (see SOW) but we should validate their migration resourcing and rollback plan

Ask:
1) Monica - please confirm SOC2 evidence is acceptable and flag any compliance gaps.
2) Laura - can Finance & Procurement provisionally approve spend path for AE-2025-4832 if Legal signs off on redlines and we get PO? Confirm if we need a POC or pilot purchase order first.
3) All - any objections to pursuing consolidation with AlphaEngage over staying with Outreach + bespoke connector?

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 10:32:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: AlphaEngage final quote and SOC2

Thanks for the flag, Marcus. I reviewed the SOC2 report they attached; coverage looks reasonable but there are two notes:

1) The report indicates subservice provider usage for our data processing tier (they rely on a managed DB provider). We need a subprocessor list and confirmation of contractual flow-down for data access controls.
2) Encryption-at-rest and key rotation details are high-level; request a KMS integration overview and evidence of key rotation policies.

Procurement note: attached a short procurement checklist — we'll need the SOW to include a clear rollback plan, acceptance criteria for the migration, and a SLA for data sync failures (target RTO/RPO).

Also recommend we request a 45-day pilot for the most critical Sales pods (AE + SDR) before committing the full seat count; that reduces risk. If they won't budge on pilot timing, push for additional credit on final invoice instead.

I've attached procurement_checklist.xlsx for Finance/Procurement input.

Monica Patel
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

From: Tim O'Neal <tim.oneal@alpha-engage.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rebecca Lin <r.lin@alpha-engage.com>, sales@alpha-engage.com
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AlphaEngage final quote and SOC2 / Pilot and SLA

Hi Monica and team,

Thanks for the detailed review. Quick answers to your items:
- Subprocessors: please find the full subprocessor list attached (included in SOC2 package). We commit to flow-down clauses for any processors handling Redwood data and can sign the standard DPAs.
- KMS: we support customer-keyed encryption via our KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS). I attached a short KMS primer and our Ops runbook excerpt that shows key rotation cadence.
- Pilot: we can do a 45-day pilot for up to 20 seats covering AE + SDR templates. We'll provide migration assistance for the pilot cohort at no charge.
- SLA: we propose a standard 99.5% platform SLA with credits outlined in the SOW. For data sync incidents we can add a targeted RTO of 4 hours for critical sync flows in the SOW (will add explicit acceptance criteria).

Attachments: SOC2_Report_2024.pdf, SOW_AlphaEngage_Migration_v1.docx, AlphaEngage_Quote_20250610.pdf, redlines_alphaengage_contract.pdf

Next step: I'll upload the DocuSign package once we confirm pilot terms and the final seat count. If Procurement needs a contract redline call, I'm available Thursday.

Best,
Tim O'Neal
Director, Strategic Accounts | AlphaEngage
